description: Reliance Chemotex Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of synthetic and blended yarns in India. The company offers home furnishing yarns, such as carpets, upholstery, and automotive; industrial yarns, such as awnings, protective wear, medical aids, and filtration; apparel yarns, such as knitwear, suiting, and melange; and technical and dope-dyed yarns. It serves automobiles, home furnishings, industrial textiles, technical textiles, and other industries. The company also exports its products. Reliance Chemotex Industries Limited was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Mumbai, India.
